target.title: fix(realtime): preserve reconnect backoff across flaps
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Realtime transcription websocket sessions reset the reconnect counter on every raw `open`, so an upstream that opens, reaches ready, then drops repeatedly never hits `maxReconnectAttempts` and never grows backoff. That can produce an unbounded reconnect stream at the base delay across websocket transcription providers.

Closes #102251.

## Solution

- Stop resetting `reconnectAttempts` in the raw websocket `open` handler.
- Reset reconnect attempts only after a reconnect has remained connected and ready for a stable window.
- Clear the stable reset timer on close/force-close.
- Add a local websocket regression that flaps after ready and asserts the reconnect limit fires after 3 retries.

## Evidence

Before the fix, a ready-then-close flap could reopen indefinitely because every raw `open` reset `reconnectAttempts` to 0.

After the fix, the regression test uses `maxReconnectAttempts: 3` and `reconnectDelayMs: 5`; it observes exactly 4 opens total (initial + 3 reconnects) and the owned `"test realtime transcription reconnect limit reached"` error.

Validation run locally:

- `node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/realtime-transcription/websocket-session.test.ts`
- `pnpm tsgo:prod`
- `pnpm check:test-types`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/realtime-transcription/websocket-session.ts src/realtime-transcription/websocket-session.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

## Impact

A flapping realtime transcription upstream is bounded instead of reconnecting forever at the base delay. This reduces repeated websocket handshakes, provider control-plane calls, and queued-audio reflush churn during provider/network instability.

## AI assistance

Implemented with AI assistance; reviewed and validated locally.
